subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-class JSON-RPC child-process plugin ABI for language-agnostic plugins, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98005 be the canonical shape?
rationale: This changes public plugin API and child-process trust boundaries, so source inspection can confirm the gap but cannot decide the permanent ABI, supported surfaces, or acceptable security tradeoffs.

options.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the implementation candidate and decide the final ABI, supported registrations, and security requirements there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow the ABI first
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a smaller initial protocol surface if maintainers want fewer plugin capabilities crossing the process boundary in v1.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or park the linked PR only if maintainers decide language-agnostic code plugins are outside current plugin SDK priorities.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the implementation candidate and decide the final ABI, supported registrations, and security requirements there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa opened the maintainer issue, authored the linked implementation candidate, and has related plugin SDK history.
